user.title: Climate Flow Scheduler
user.description: Adds the scheduler integration; programs are configured with its services.

invalid_time.message: Times must use the HH:MM 24-hour format.

invalid_hvac_mode.message: hvac_mode must be one of off, heat, cool, auto, dry, fan_only, or heat_cool.

unsupported_hvac_mode.message: HVAC mode {mode} is not available for this climate entity.

entity_validation_failed.message: The climate entity does not accept this program: {message}

no_program.message: No schedule exists for this climate entity.

too_many_slots.message: A program may contain at most {max} slots.

empty_enabled_program.message: An enabled program needs at least one slot.

invalid_away_temperature.message: The outside-schedule temperature must be a finite number.

invalid_slot_schema.message: Each slot needs id, days, start, end, and temperature.

invalid_slot_id.message: Slot id must start alphanumeric and use letters, digits, dots, underscores, or hyphens.

invalid_days.message: days must be a non-empty list of ISO weekdays 1..7.

climate_range_unavailable.message: The climate temperature range or step is unavailable.

climate_range_invalid.message: The climate temperature range or step is invalid.

target_outside_limits.message: Target {value} is outside the climate limits.

target_off_step.message: Target {value} is not aligned to the climate temperature step.

heat_cool_unsupported.message: A single target cannot be applied while the climate runs heat_cool; both target temperatures are required.

heat_cool_dual_required.message: A heat_cool program needs both temperatures in every slot.

dual_range_invalid.message: The low target {low} must stay below the high target {high}.

dual_slot_unsupported.message: A slot with two target temperatures needs heat_cool: set the program mode to heat_cool or use one temperature.

mixed_slots_mode_required.message: A program with single and range slots needs hvac_mode for its single-target slots.

invalid_override_duration.message: Choose a valid manual override duration.

no_next_change.message: There is no upcoming schedule boundary.

override_hvac_off.message: Manual overrides are unavailable when the program sets HVAC off.

pause_hvac_off.message: A vacation pause is unavailable when the program sets HVAC off.

invalid_override_step.message: The override step must be a finite positive number.
